copy_contents: copy files or directories from source to destination using symlinks or hard copies
extract_all_archives: extract all zip archives in a directory tree and remove the original zip files
prepare_configuration: prepare and validate an OmegaConf configuration by resolving paths and generating experiment names
remove_unwanted_items: remove unwanted files and directories like __MACOSX and .DS_Store from a directory tree
display_configuration: display an OmegaConf configuration in formatted YAML style with syntax highlighting
